findings.finding: Matched-state diagnostic: the coefficient model is correct; the app drops design inputs (surface finish, turbulence, fin airfoil/bevels/LE radius, rail guides/lugs/shoe), causing the 8.3-40.8% (per-flight mean) CD gap. Corrected inputs match the engine to 0.001-0.456% per-flight mean CD; the hybrid remains 0.09-6.86% and the 6-DOF/table replay difference remains 0.1-7.9% on 8/9. Mass/CG/thrust histories were not measured (empty comparison, n=0), so the replay residual is not attributed to the solver alone. Corrected per independent review (MatchedStateReview, 2026-11-02).
findings.disposition: Flight path held; fix proposal deferred (typed input plumbing needs the input source/UI and airfoil mapping). No tuning, no gate change, no merge.

findings.finding: Design-input plumbing implemented on branch frontend/design: surface finish, forced turbulence, nozzle exit, body-tube rail guide/lug/shoe and fin airfoil section/bevels/LE radius now reach the calibrated method; airfoil maps to Subsonic NACA unless overridden. Browser check: M2.00 CD 0.462 -> 0.480 with surface/turbulence/nozzle, and rail hardware/fin section change it further; save/open persists. Full vitest 1781 pass, engine/core cargo tests pass.

composition.mechanism: total-CD blend with the legacy total over Mach 0.80-1.20; C1 smoothstep weights (0 below 0.80, 1 on 0.90-1.05, 0 above 1.20); weights sum to one so the method's transonic rise is weighted out
composition.referenceAtmosphere: sea-level standard day (ISA 1976) for both totals, recorded in curve metadata
composition.breakdown: withheld inside the band (flag true for the curve); no mixed-source stack
composition.limitation: inside the band the composed CD is the legacy total, so the build-up base/protuberance/friction terms are overridden there; the model is labeled hybrid and is not the method-only model. C08 parity applies to the provider alone and is not quoted for the hybrid.

candidates.measured: 9 single-stage flights; 24 of 27 metrics above 0.5%; worst kinsel apogee 29.29%; hybrid mean apogee 10.27% vs legacy 17.90% (hybrid better on 4/9 apogee, 8/9 maxV, 4/9 TTA).
candidates.attribution: Site temperature/pressure and nozzle exit do not explain the residual; best apogee with both is 3.74%, most combinations make it worse; the provider nozzle input affects drag only while the engine also applies pressure thrust, so the attribution is incomplete but not overstating help.

matchedState.finding: AERO INPUT defect, not the coefficient model. With the design inputs the engine used (surface finish, turbulent flag, fin airfoil section/bevels/LE radius, rail guide/lug/shoe), sourced from each corpus design.json (no fitting, no engine CD read back), the method CD residual collapses to 0.001-0.456% per-flight mean (pooled 0.123%); base inputs are 8.3-40.8% low. The hybrid remains 0.09-6.86% because the legacy override replaces drag in 0.80-1.20. CP per-flight mean 0-2.26% (per-row max 6.81%, raven). Mass/CG/thrust: NOT measured; the burn comparison vectors are never populated (n=0), so the report's 0.000% is not a measurement.
matchedState.solver: Engine-CD replay through our 6-DOF: 0.1-7.9% apogee on 8/9 flights; qu8k replay is not a valid bound because the core table is Mach-only while the engine CD varies ~1.5x with altitude at fixed Mach. This is a 6-DOF/table replay difference; it cannot be attributed to the solver alone while mass/CG/thrust are unverified. It remains above 0.5% and is not fixed by inputs.
matchedState.defect: FrontendVehicle drops surfaceFinish/forceTurbulentFlow; FrontendComponent and aero Component lack airfoilSection, leadingEdgeBevel, trailingEdgeBevel, leadingEdgeRadius, railGuideDiameter, railGuideHeight, launchShoeArea; the adapter hard-codes None/derives the airfoil. Kinsel M2.0 fin interference: engine ~0.494 vs app ~0.071.
matchedState.fixProposal: Implemented on branch frontend/design as typed plumbing: vehicle surfaceFinish/forceTurbulentFlow/nozzleExitDiameter, body-tube rail guide/lug/shoe, fin airfoilSection/bevels/LE radius, through TS types, project JSON, engine DTO, aero::Vehicle design inputs, component_input and design_from_app_vehicle. Airfoil cross-section now maps to Subsonic NACA unless an explicit section is chosen. No formula change.
receipts: corpus/kinsel-p4935-a-601-rocket/points.csv (engine corpus, not shipped; finInterfSup 0.4943 at M2.0)
matchedState.disposition: Flight path remains held; C10 not run. The input defect is fixed on the frontend/design branch and verified in the production UI (drag changes with the inputs, save/open round-trip); the separate solver/table difference remains, so the 0.5% end-to-end gate is not expected to pass.
matchedState.review: Independent review MatchedStateReview (2026-11-02): ACCEPT-WITH-CORRECTIONS. Input defect, provenance (design.json, no circularity), matched-state method/CP results and replay/table bound confirmed; test-only code, production paths unchanged. Corrected: base range (was 16-41%), corrected mean (was ~1.3e-5, blister only), mass/CG/thrust 0.000% withdrawn (n=0), 1c maxV count (was 5/9), CP qualified as mean.
